decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's strategic direction of binding mobile communication, and keeping it costs little because it builds on existing infrastructure, so the option stays open despite limited visibility.
It was promoted to its own page in 2019 and forms the architectural backbone of the firm's integrated offering, which signals positive resolution of uncertainty and justifies continued commitment.

The hardware token gained its own page and serves regulated transaction-signing demand, but hardware carries higher holding costs and is exposed to substitution by app-based authentication, so it remains an option worth monitoring rather than dropping.
Payment-security compliance remains demanded under regulations such as PSD2, and the suite leverages existing know-how at low marginal cost, though its mere mentions suggest modest traction.
